page.layout: One printed page: one column of running text. Small margin notes run down the left margin, partly hidden by red scan marks and too damaged to read, so they are not transcribed. Running head at top centre, page number at top left. No catchword or signature.

main_text.p: ipsi [illegible, ~7 letters] tenerent, primi sententias dicerent, ab omnibus magistratibus olim iisdem aslurgeretur. Deinde &c ager iis latior assignatus fuit à Lycurgo, ad tuendum statum regium, modicus tamen, qui nec indigere eos mediocribus, nec affluere divitiis permitteret.

In cœnis quoque &c conviviis publicis duplex portio ipsis est tributa, ut haberent, quod aliis, quos honorare volebant, possent elargiri: ex singulis sacrificiis pars aliqua regibus data: ex quolibet scropharum partu porcellus unus iisdem cessit, ne sacra facturis victima unquam deesset. Erant omnium sacrorum administri quasi sacerdotes, & sacrificabant frequenter. Adhæc habitabant domo publicâ, & utebantur publicis tabernaculis tum ad cænas, tum ad usus alios, semperque secum habebant contubernales Pythios, binos & [illegible, ~2 letters]s, quos pro re natâ mitterent ad consulenda oracula: Pythios etiam & proxenos, quibus cura excipiendorum & tractandorum hospitum publicorum demandata, soli pro arbitrio suo signabant: causas virginum ἐπι- ἐπικλήρων seu πατρόχων [?], quibus solis torrentum hæreditas obveniebat, deoque certatim à pluribus procis ferè pete-

page.notes: Left margin: several small margin notes are present but are obscured by red scan marks and cannot be read; they are not transcribed. Doubtful readings: the first Greek word on line 1 ("ipsi ... tenerent") is not legible with certainty and is marked as illegible. "ἐπικλήρων seu πατρόχων" is read with uncertainty; the second Greek word ends in [?]. "binos & [illegible]s" is partly illegible, with words hidden at the line break. "signabant" may be "significabant" with letters lost. Long s printed as "f" is transcribed as "s" (e.g. "aslurgeretur"). The text ends with a hyphen at the page foot ("pete-"), continuing on the next page.
